ev.q: investigated three cases of Escherichia coli O157:H7 infection in a Japanese family
investigated three cases of Escherichia coli O157:H7 infection in a Japanese family
This report summarizes epidemiologic and laboratory investigations conducted by OCHC and OIHE.

methods_quotes.q: Cases were ascertained through surveillance for laboratory-confirmed E. coli O157:H7 infection.
PFGE patterns were analyzed and transmitted electronically to PulseNet USA* at CDC for comparison with U.S. isolates.
